title: Diet Plan Performance
description: Calculate total points based on calories consumed in K-day intervals: +1 if total > upper, -1 if total < lower, 0 otherwise.
pseudocode:
1. total = 0, points = 0
2. for i from 0 to calories.length - 1:
3.   total += calories[i]
4.   if i >= k:
5.     total -= calories[i - k]
6.   if i >= k - 1:
7.     if total < lower: points -= 1
8.     else if total > upper: points += 1

steps.note: Initialize variables with calories = [1, 2, 3], k = 2, lower = 3, upper = 4
Add calories[1]=2 to total. total is 3
Window full (i >= k-1). Compare total (3) with lower (3) and upper (4)
total (3) is not less than lower (3). points remains 0
Add calories[2]=3 to total. total is 6
Remove oldest element: calories[2-2]=1. total becomes 5
